name: Saint Monica
history: A Christian woman of North Africa, married to a hot-tempered pagan, whose patience won him to the faith before he died. For years she prayed and wept for her son Augustine, who had abandoned the faith, and followed him to Italy. She saw him baptised in Milan and died soon after at Ostia.
life: Almost all we know of Monica comes from her son’s Confessions. She was born at Thagaste in North Africa and married Patricius, a pagan official whose temper and infidelity she bore with patience; he was baptised shortly before his death. Of her children, Augustine caused her the deepest grief, living with a mistress and joining the Manichees. She prayed and wept for him for years, and a bishop she begged for help told her it was not possible that the son of so many tears should be lost. When Augustine left secretly for Rome she followed him there and on to Milan, where she came to love Saint Ambrose. At Easter 387 she saw her son baptised. Waiting to sail home, they stood at a window at Ostia and spoke together of eternal life. Days later she fell ill. She asked only that they remember her at the altar of the Lord, and died aged fifty-six.
prayerTo: Saint Monica, patient wife and faithful mother, you never stopped praying for your son. I bring you those I love who have fallen away from the faith. Pray that God will bring them home, and give me your patience, your hope and your perseverance in prayer. Amen.
penance: Pray today for a family member or friend who has drifted from the faith, and offer a small fast, such as going without a snack or a treat, for them.
meditation: It is not possible that the son of so many tears should be lost. For whom are you weeping and praying, and do you still hope?
